risk.rationale: Verified evidence shows suspicious sign-ins from an out-of-baseline Cloudvault VPS ASN (DE) under T1078.004 (F1, confirmed 0.52) and a VPN appliance (vpn-edge-01) running firmware with multiple CISA KEV-listed CVEs under T1133/T1190 (F3, confirmed 0.49), with most sign-ins originating from DE (F2, likely 0.5). However, all findings carry low confidence, and there is an active data-quality conflict (DQ vpn_session_order failing for appliance:vpn-edge-01) that prevents reliable correlation of VPN sessions to the suspicious sign-ins. This constitutes exposure (KEV-listed edge device) combined with conflicting/insufficient evidence to confirm an account-takeover chain, requiring human review rather than automated containment or benign closure.
